grades.quote: Complex atomic memory operations on a single memory word or doubleword are performed with the load-reserved (LR) and store-conditional (SC) instructions.
grades.reason: This passage describes RISC-V's load-reserved/store-conditional (LR/SC) instructions. They are the analogue of ARM's LDREX/STREX. It explains the reservation set, SC success and failure reporting through rd, and their use for atomic updates and lock-free structures. It does not mention ARM or locks by name, but it answers the core question.
